title: [elegance] SmtpRelayQueue enqueue: atomic write order allows orphaned .msg files
description: Lines 98-114 in relay_queue.rs write .msg first, then .env. If a crash occurs between the two renames, an orphaned .msg exists without .env (handled at lines 196-199, but as dead code). Better order: write both .tmp files, rename .msg.tmp → .msg, then rename .env.tmp → .env. This way, a crash leaves either both files (both renames succeeded) or neither (before second rename). Minor issue since orphan handling exists, but not the most robust design.
